role: Builds .venv-codemap for the code map: picks a Python 3.10+ interpreter (tree-sitter 0.26 needs it; macOS's own python3 is 3.9), recreates the venv with it (--clear, so a venv an older interpreter made is rebuilt) and installs scripts/codemap/requirements.txt with hashes required. Run by `make codemap-setup` when the venv is missing or cannot import tree-sitter.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; cd to the repo root. Without a 3.10+ interpreter: prints which python3 was found and how to supply one, exit 1. Otherwise: python -m venv --clear .venv-codemap, pip install --quiet --disable-pip-version-check --require-hashes -r scripts/codemap/requirements.txt, prints the interpreter version used.

units.does: Prints the first interpreter that is Python 3.10 or newer among CODEMAP_BASE_PYTHON (when set), python3.13, python3.12, python3.11, python3.10 and python3, and returns 0; returns 1 when none on PATH is.

branches.cond: candidate empty or not on PATH
